items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: let's see if I can remember that song Tati used to sing.

ctx.x: I bet you remember some Mardi Gras songs. I bet you do. Mardi Gras?

Mardi Gras songs. Well, uh, let's see if I can remember that song Tati used to sing. Fum, fum, quitte mo balikala, a je fum abadra, that's no good for nothing. Fum, fum, quitte mo balikala, a je fum abadra, tu barrasé moi. Fum, fum, quitte mo balikala, a je fum abadra, tu barrasé moi. Well, that's Mardi Gras song.
Could we get a translation of that, since it's part real and part does something about it? How does that go in English? What would the words be? Say, what would the words be in English?
